missions.title: The Burning Sea of Suffering
missions.description: At this very moment, the entire Frankfurt is burning.

missions.title: Like a Scorching Wind
missions.description: The bombardment that struck without warning has left the entire city paralyzed. The trapped Commander extends a helping hand to the citizens.

missions.title: The Silent Folds
missions.description: Laplace's last words continue to resound in Nele's ears. With her hands soaked in blood, she once again finds herself in a dilemma.

missions.title: The Futile Path
missions.description: Groß has been waiting for this moment for far too long.

missions.title: The Defeated Knight of Sorrow
missions.description: She caresses the ice-cold incubation pod. This womb that birthed her will eventually also be her tomb.

missions.title: The Rain That Never Ceases
missions.description: I shall take his place and continue to gaze upon this blood-soaked world.

missions.title: Holding Up the Torch for You
missions.description: The bombardment persists. There is seemingly no end to the dull rumble.

missions.title: A Forgotten Vow
missions.description: As long as we're alive, there will always be something that must be done, something that simply can't be avoided.

missions.title: The Path to a New World
missions.description: In times of disaster, there will always be those who step forward and be the bulwark for others.

missions.title: The Long Night Stirs in Desolation
missions.description: After a day of toil, the Commander revisits that fateful day many years ago in their dreams...

missions.title: The Wall That Stands Through Time
missions.description: Nobody cares whether the civilians live or die; someone has to step forward and do something. This is why I have picked up arms.

missions.title: Sand and Seawater by the Shore
missions.description: All we can do is take a bath of humanity and bow to destiny. Go and do what we can do.

missions.title: A Brave Soul
missions.description: If I die one day, please inscribe this as my epitaph, "Here lies a brave soul."

missions.title: The Dragon That Gnaws at Tree Roots
missions.description: With the enactment of the Níðhöggr Agreement, all IOP Dolls will cease operating and have their command authorizations withdrawn.

missions.title: Beyond Words, the World is Cold
missions.description: While the world rejoices at the establishment of the URNC, Nele discovers a conspiracy brewing in the shadows of the draft...

missions.title: The Piercing Red
missions.description: In order to sabotage Project Valkyrie, the Commander leads their remaining Dolls in a charge to where the final operation will take place.

missions.title: A Lonely Soul's Prayer
missions.description: The agent codenamed "Angelia" will always be your comrade-in-arms in whichever world, no matter what choices were made.

missions.title: A Flame Burning in a Desolate World
missions.description: Having made a courageous choice, Nele is arrested, but thanks to her grandfather's help, she manages to get out of danger unscathed.

missions.title: The Final Move
missions.description: Congratulations to you—and me—on finally reaching a resolution.

missions.title: A Song of Defiance
missions.description: Commander, please let me have my way just this once... This is my only choice...

missions.title: The Story of Your Life I
missions.description: With a new mission, so comes a new dawn.

missions.title: The Story of Your Life II
missions.description: We have been backing down again and again... and now, there is no more room for retreat.

missions.title: The Story of Your Life III
missions.description: This is human nature. Humanity will never be truly united, for money is the real force of unity.

missions.title: The Story of Your Life IV
missions.description: We are just in different camps, but we both love our motherland dearly at the end of the day.

missions.title: The Story of Your Life V
missions.description: This is our one last chance to save the motherland. We either bring forth a reborn Neo-Soviet Union... or die for her.

missions.title: The Story of Your Life VI
missions.description: Today marked the longest, most arduous fight in my life. And much to my shame, I survived.

missions.title: The Story of Your Life VII
missions.description: This is our country. This is our land.
